integrity: Complete proof and a standalone standard-library exact rational checker are included. No independent validation or external mathematical audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Connected simple cactus with strictly positive scalar edge-generator weights; population covariance in labeled Euclidean incidence coordinates; no noisy-data stability or noncactus result. Exact low-dimensional convex-hull computations corroborate the general proof but do not replace it. Historical priority may be affected by unindexed general box-spline moment or inverse-geometry results.
title: Population-covariance tomography for arbitrarily weighted cactus graphical zonotopes
